newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Renong unit to sell land for 118 mln rgt.
newsitem.headline: Renong unit to sell land for 118 mln rgt.

text.p: A subsidiary of Renong Bhd has proposed to dispose two lots of land of 103.4 hectares (255.5 acres) for 118 million ringgit each in the state of Johor, the national Bernama news agency said on Monday.
The proposed buyers of the two plots from Renong's 64 percent owned Prolink Development Sdn Bhd were Glomac Consolidated Sdn Bhd and Mega Grand Sdn Bhd, Renong's merchant bankers said in a statement.
The proposed disposals would result in a pre-tax gain of about 105 million ringgit at the Renong group level.
The gain would be recognised as income progressively in accordance with the cost of the land plus the cost to be incurred for the primary infrastructure, said Bernama.
